description:
Gift ideas from Man of Many's published gift guides, filtered by recipient, budget and interests.

    Each pick carries the guide it is from, the price as published and the retailer link as published.

budget_aud.description: Optional maximum spend per gift in Australian dollars, as a number (e.g. 100).
budget_aud.title: Budget Aud

interests.description: Optional comma-separated interests of the recipient, e.g. "golf, whisky". Picks matching these rank first.
interests.title: Interests

limit.description: Number of gift ideas to return, 1 to 20. Default 10.
limit.title: Limit

recipient.description: Who the gift is for, e.g. "dad", "boyfriend", "groomsmen", "coffee lover".
recipient.title: Recipient

name: gift_finder
title: Gift finder
